newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends mixed but holds gains vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends mixed but holds gains vs dlr.

text.p: 1600 GMT - The Swiss franc closed higher versus the dollar and dealers expected the consolidation of the hefty gains seen thus far this year to continue in the near-term.

The mark closed higher on the franc amid fresh EMU concerns. * Dollar closes at 1.4563/4569 francs vs 1.4624/4634, seen holding a near-term range of 1.4300/4600 francs. * Mark ends at 86.22/24 centimes vs 85.94/95 Friday close. It's near-term range was put at 85.50/86.50 centimes. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
